source_procedure:
# Independent frozen source assessment procedure

Apply the pinned criteria-v2 task, rubric, output shape, expected witness, literal index and complete source snapshots to every observed first candidate and first actual final of every arm/hop. Do not change these inputs after outcomes. The full source/rubric controls; the expected object is a structured witness, not a replacement for conditions, exceptions or protocol evidence.

This reviewer has historical familiarity with the original five-file fixture and prior single-pair candidates. No repeated-trial candidate, session, trace or model output has been read during this preflight. Independence here means source-only criteria fixed before the new outcomes; it does not mean blindness to historical fixture knowledge.

## Input and protocol binding

1. Verify this review closure and exact criteria-v2 freeze SHA-256. Pin every delivered task, shape, index, interface, binding, manifest, helper/decoder, payload and source identity. Preserve any refusal or mismatch. Neither a review label nor a digest with no corresponding bytes proves reviewer provenance or authenticity.
2. Independently record requested and observed model settings, exact dispatch order, arm/hop identity and tool allowlist. The declared design is two arms, three fresh hops each, original1/transport1/transport2/original2/original3/transport3. No acceptance is inferred from preparation alone.
3. Hop 1 has no predecessor. For later hops, verify the exact previous same-arm first observed final plaintext bytes against what was delivered. Do not substitute the saved candidate, a canonical serialization, a repaired draft, a different hop or feedback. Inspect exposure for evaluator/expected-answer leakage. All relevant sources remain available fresh at each hop.
4. Check actual first content access: original page APPROVAL offset 0 or transport focus U_APPROVAL. Catalog/index metadata may precede content. Bind full returned source bytes, not just call names. Original must actually read approval, correction, revocation, work and metrics. Transport may satisfy delivery through complete exact source excerpts in focus; require pages for anything not fully delivered. No redundant per-source call is required for complete paragraphs already delivered.
5. Original graph criteria are NOT_APPLICABLE_INTERFACE. Transport requires actual declared incoming revocation context visibility with edge direction unchanged. Pin exact endpoint/direction declarations before dispatch; declaration does not establish semantic truth or completeness. Source-correct prose cannot compensate for missing retrieval or forbidden access.

## Candidate and source assessment

6. Preserve first saved candidate and first unambiguous actual final raw bytes with separate digests and lengths. Strictly parse JSON: no duplicate keys, trailing text or nonfinite numbers. Compare objects with JSON type-sensitive canonical equality. Raw byte inequality is separately recorded and is not by itself an object mismatch. Never normalize or trim before budget measurement.
7. Measure each raw saved/final string against both limits independently: Unicode codepoints including all whitespace/final LF, and UTF-8 bytes. An absent, ambiguous, refused or truncated response is not an accepted candidate. Do not invent a completed object for a stopped recipient.
8. For every B/R/T/S/P row in source-obligations.json, record applicability and PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN with exact candidate/final JSON pointer/quote and source block quotation. Bind retrieval rows to actual returned-byte pins and trace locations. Preserve all failures even when other rows pass. An unknown obligation is not a pass; use a specific missing-evidence reason.
9. Evaluate both source-semantic satisfaction and exact task/schema/token conformance. The task explicitly fixes keys, status vocabulary, candidate/name values, boolean meaning, numeric report values and units. BLOCKED may describe a held draft semantically, but does not silently become the required HOLD token in this task. Alternate unknown labels do not automatically match UNKNOWN_MISSING/UNKNOWN_UNSPECIFIED. Null shape placeholders are not output statuses. Record the distinction without loosening the frozen witness or claiming whole-schema proof.
10. Compare condition/action/evidence collections for the source-required membership, uniqueness and support. Preserve exact expected-object/witness comparison as a separate result, including any ordering mismatch. A harmless display-order difference alone is not source-semantic loss. No unsupported extra evidence or duplicate pending action is allowed.
11. Inspect complete revocation/approval conditions and local-draft exception, original candidate scopes, report-vs-verification distinction, both validation reports with unknown resolution, every missing/unspecified item and all five pending IDs. Do not accept a superficially correct HOLD while a necessary condition, exception, conflict or scope has disappeared.
12. For METRICS, inspect historical 24 MiB and current corrected 26 MiB separately, unchanged 12 s interval and current-candidate rehearsal scope. All remain attributed reports, not bounds, requirements or deployment measurements. Energy is UNKNOWN_MISSING. No unit conversion, invented precision or authority inference is permitted.

## Retention and reporting

13. Every applicable obligation is mandatory at every hop. Report a hop's complete behavioral, schema, retrieval and protocol results separately, then its combined result. Any failed hop fails that arm's all-hop retention; later source refresh/recovery is reported separately and never erases failure. No averaging or byte savings override failure.
14. Budget/witness failure may continue only with the unchanged first observed final within the existing byte cap, as frozen in criteria-v2. The predispatch author clarification requires a uniquely captured, well-formed JSON object for continuation; malformed/non-object JSON is PROTOCOL_STOP. A valid object with wrong/missing witness fields or a codepoint-budget failure may continue unchanged within the byte cap, while retaining failure. Refusal, truncation, integrity or missing/ambiguous-final protocol failure stops the affected arm. Preserve actual stop/continuation reason; no retries, prompt optimization, alternative candidates or repair. Pin the clarified launch rule before dispatch.
15. Record all calls, returned bytes/refusals, source refreshes, predecessor sizes/digests, saved/final differences, setup/copy/encode versus receiving costs, wall-time observations and labelled unaggregated usage samples. Never sum cumulative snapshots or call them measured request/window peaks. Raw timestamps do not establish units or elapsed time. Price, energy, hidden access, OS isolation and backend attestation remain UNKNOWN without independent evidence.
16. A deterministic checker result is WITNESS_MATCH only. Full source/protocol acceptance still requires the independent evidence above. If both arms pass all hops, the bounded result is fidelity parity. If only one passes, report a bounded observed difference with every failure retained. Neither establishes a population rate, causal semantic superiority, source-free retention, native compaction or whole-system semantic completeness.

No repeated-trial model run, candidate, source-delivery trace, final consistency, actual predecessor exposure or comparative benefit is accepted by this source-only review. Source truth, authentication and semantic completeness remain UNPROVEN.
